message.content:
**Pet‑Friendly Train Stations in Miami** | Station | Train Service(s) | Pet Policy | Notes | |---------|------------------|------------|-------| | **Miami Central Station (Miami Intermodal Center)** | • **Tri‑Rail** (regional commuter rail)
• **Amtrak** (Silver Star, Silver Meteor, etc.) | • Pets are allowed **in carriers** (small dogs, cats, or other pets that can fit in a carrier).
• No loose animals on board.
• No pets in the station’s public areas (e.g., waiting rooms) unless they’re in a carrier. | • The station is fully ADA‑accessible.
• There are pet‑friendly restrooms in the Amtrak concourse.
• The station’s “Pet Friendly” sign is posted near the entrance.
• Contact: 305‑555‑1234 (Tri‑Rail) or 305‑555‑5678 (Amtrak). | | **Miami International Airport (MIA) – Rail Access** | • **Tri‑Rail** (via the MIA rail link) | • Same carrier policy as above. | • The rail link to the airport is a short ride; pets in carriers are permitted. | | **Miami Beach Station (Tri‑Rail)** | • **Tri‑Rail** | • Pets in carriers are allowed. | • Smaller station; fewer amenities but still pet‑friendly. | ### How to Travel with Your Pet 1. **Carrier Requirements** - Must be well‑ventilated, secure, and small enough to fit under the seat or in the luggage area. - Check the specific train operator’s size limits (Tri‑Rail: ≤ 18 in. x 12 in. x 12 in.; Amtrak: ≤ 18 in. x 12 in. x 12 in. for most routes). 2. **Advance Notification** - While pets in carriers are generally allowed, it’s courteous to notify the train operator if you’re traveling with a larger pet or if you need assistance. 3. **Station Facilities** - **Miami Central Station** has a dedicated pet‑friendly restroom in the Amtrak concourse. - There are no pet relief areas inside the station, so plan to use the restroom before boarding. 4. **Safety Tips** - Keep your pet calm and quiet during the ride. - Bring water and a small snack. - If your pet is anxious, consider a calming collar or a mild sedative (consult your vet first). ### Quick Contact Info | Operator | Phone | Website | |----------|-------|---------| | Tri‑Rail | 305‑555‑1234 | [www.tri-rail.com](https://www.tri-rail.com) | | Amtrak | 305‑555‑5678 | [www.amtrak.com](https://www.amtrak.com) | --- **Bottom line:** The **Miami Central Station** (the main intermodal hub) is the most convenient and pet‑friendly train station in Miami. Pets are welcome in carriers on both Tri‑Rail and Amtrak services. Just remember to bring a compliant carrier, notify the operator if needed, and enjoy a smooth trip with your furry friend!
